scope: Serialize existing manually dispatched Paperless canary behind existing full CI without cancellation or another dispatch loop
review: Independent remote review of GitHub concurrency semantics; active predecessor historical policy does not cause incoming false run to cancel it
dispatchBoundary: Root inspects all in_progress queued waiting pending requested runs immediately before one dispatch
Do not replace any already pending heavy successor
Verify returned run/head and pending state while original active owner remains unchanged
Later scheduler/manual entrants can replace a pending run; inspect before any retry, no FIFO or eventual-completion claim
